- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext TFree TFreeTyping HeapCorrespondence ConfigVarkinds NothingFresh ConfigNotations.

Section WithTypingMode.

Inductive ty_stack : ctx -> renv -> typ -> stack -> typ -> Prop :=
  | ty_stack_nil : forall G e T U,
      G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
      ty_stack G e T stack_nil U
  | ty_stack_let : forall L G e s t S T U,
      ty_stack G e T s U ->
      (forall x,
          x \notin L ->
          G § x / v_let ~ S ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ T) ->
      ty_stack G e S (stack_cons (frame_let t) s) U.

Inductive heap_closed: heap -> Prop :=
| heap_closed_empty: heap_closed empty
| heap_closed_push S x i:
    heap_closed S ->
    closed i ->
    heap_closed (S & x ~ i)
.

Inductive config_closed: config -> Prop:=
  config_sealed_cfg t s Sigma e Lv:
    closed t ->
    closed s ->
    heap_closed Sigma ->
    config_closed (t; s; Sigma; e; Lv).

Inductive ty_config : ctx -> config -> typ -> Prop :=
| ty_config_c : forall G e s Sigma Lv t T U,
    inert G ->
    heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
    ty_stack G e T s U ->
    all_tfree_k_stack G s v_ref ->
    G⁏e ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    all_tfree_k G t v_ref ->
    ty_nothing_fresh_in_config G U (t ; s ; Sigma ; e; Lv) ->
    has_null Lv ->
    sealed G ->
    config_closed (t; s; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    closed U ->
    ty_config G (t; s; Sigma; e; Lv) U.

Inductive config_typd : config -> typ -> Prop :=
| config_typd_c : forall Gamma c U,
    ty_config Gamma c U ->
    config_typd c U.

Inductive config_hastyp : config -> Prop :=
| config_hastyp_c : forall Gamma c U,
    ty_config Gamma c U ->
    config_hastyp c.

Notation "'⊢' c '∶' T" := (config_typd c T) (at level 40, c at level 59).

Notation config_initial_mk_typ t T null := (t; stack_nil; empty; empty; \{ null } \u fv t \u fv T) (only parsing).

Inductive config_initial: trm -> config -> Prop :=

End WithTypingMode.

Notation "'⊢' c '∶' T" := (config_typd _ c T) (at level 40, c at level 59).

    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->

Inductive red_closure :  config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=

Require Export TypingMode TypingContext.

Notation EnvProperty A B := (forall (e:renv) (v: A) (T: B), Prop).

Notation TypingProperty A B := (forall (G:ctx) (Go: objctx) (e:renv) (v: A) (T: B), Prop).

Class DecTyping (A : Set) := obj_dec_typing: ctx -> objctx -> renv -> A -> dec -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶d' T" := (obj_dec_typing G Go e t T) (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Class Typing (A : Set) := obj_typing: ctx -> objctx -> renv -> A -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶' T" := (obj_typing G Go e t T) (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Notation typing G e a t := (obj_typing G objctx_empty e a t).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶' T" := (typing G e t T) (at level 40, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Notation dec_typing G e a d := (obj_dec_typing G objctx_empty e a d).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶d' T" := (dec_typing G e t T) (at level 40, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Class Subtyping := subtyping: ctx -> objctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '⁏' e '⊢' T '<:' U" := (subtyping G objctx_empty e T U) (at level 40, e at level 39, T at level 59).

Class ReferenceIncapacitate := obj_ref_incap :
                                 ctx -> objctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e  ⊢ T1 '∶icp' T2" := (obj_ref_incap G Go e T1 T2)
  (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation ref_incap G e T1 T2 := (obj_ref_incap G objctx_empty e T1 T2).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ T1 '∶icp' T2" :=
  (ref_incap G e T1 T2)
    (at level 40, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Class CapabilityBound (C : typ_refcap_label) :=
  obj_cap_bnd :
     ctx -> objctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e  ⊢ T1 '∶cpb' ⟦ C ⟧  T2" := (@obj_cap_bnd C _ G Go e T1 T2)
  (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation cap_bnd C G e T1 T2 := (@obj_cap_bnd C _ G objctx_empty e T1 T2).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ T1 '∶cpb' ⟦ C ⟧ T2" := (cap_bnd C G e T1 T2)
    (at level 40, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation typ_cap_adapt C x Tcap := (
  typ_cap_marker C (typ_or Tcap
    (typ_sel (avar_f x) (typ_label_refcap C) (avar_b 0))
  )).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive ty_var : Typing var :=

| ty_var_var : forall G e x T,
    ctx_binds x T G ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T

| ty_rec_intro : forall G e x T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open x T ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->

    ((mode_has_incap typing_mode) -> (G⁏e ⊢ (open x T) ∶icp (open x T))) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T

| ty_rec_elim : forall G e x T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open x T

| ty_var_and : forall G e x T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_and T U

| ty_var_sub : forall G e x T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ U

| ty_var_mut_top : forall G e x T,
    mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ (typ_mut_marker typ_top)

with subtyp : Subtyping :=

| subtyp_top: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: typ_top

| subtyp_bot: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot <: T

| subtyp_refl: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: T

| subtyp_trans: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: U

| subtyp_and11: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and T U <: T

| subtyp_and12: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and T U <: U

| subtyp_and2: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: typ_and T U

| subtyp_or11: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: typ_or T U

| subtyp_or12: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ U <: typ_or T U

| subtyp_or2: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ U <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_or S U <: T

| subtyp_fld: forall G e a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ U1 <: U2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T2 U1) <: typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 U2)

| subtyp_typ: forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    (forall x, G⁏e ⊢ (open x S2) <: (open x S1)) ->
    (forall x, G⁏e ⊢ (open x T1) <: (open x T2)) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) <: typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2)

| subtyp_sel2: forall G e x A y S T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (open y S) <: typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)

| subtyp_sel1: forall G e x A y S T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y) <: (open y T)

| subtyp_fun: forall L G e S1 T1 S2 T2,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       G § x / v_par ~ S2 ⁏e ⊢ open x T1 <: open x T2) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_fun S1 T1 <: typ_fun S2 T2

| subtyp_met: forall L G e m TC1 TZ1 TR1 TC2 TZ2 TR2,
    G⁏e ⊢ TZ2 <: TZ1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
    G § x / v_par ~ TZ2 ⁏e ⊢ open x TC2 <: open x TC1) ->

    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC2 -> typ_indep_b 0 TC1) ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
     forall y, y <> x -> y \notin L ->
    (ctx_met G x TZ2 y TC2) ⁏e ⊢ open_met x y TR1 <: open_met x y TR2) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC1 TZ1 TR1) <: typ_rcd (dec_met m TC2 TZ2 TR2)

| subtyp_tyq: forall G e T1 T2,
    e ⊢ T1 ≈ T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 <: T2

| subtyp_typ_and: forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    G⁏e ⊢
     typ_and
       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))
       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2))
     <: typ_rcd (dec_typ A (typ_or S1 S2) (typ_and T1 T2))

| subtyp_dist: forall G e T1 T2 T3,
    G⁏e ⊢
      typ_and T1 (typ_or T2 T3)
      <: typ_or (typ_and T1 T2) (typ_and T1 T3)

| subtyp_nocap_bnd G e T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_bnd T

| subtyp_nocap_typ G e A T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T1 T2)

| subtyp_nocap_fld G e a T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2)

| subtyp_nocap_met G e a TC TZ TR:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_met a TC TZ TR)

| subtyp_nocap_fun G e TZ TR:
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_fun TZ TR

| subtyp_nocap_mut_top_boundless G e T1 T2:
    mode_has_top_nm_subtype_boundless typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top <: (typ_or typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap typ_refcap_mutability) T1 T2)))

| subtyp_nocap_mut_top_complement G e:
    mode_has_top_nm_complement typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top <: (typ_or typ_nocap (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) )

| subtyp_nocap_mut_bot G e:
    mode_has_top_nm_complement typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (typ_and typ_nocap (typ_mut_marker typ_bot)) <: typ_bot

| subtyp_mut_top G e:
    mode_has_mut_top typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top <: (typ_mut_marker typ_top)

with ty_incap : ReferenceIncapacitate :=

| ty_incap_top G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top ∶icp typ_top

| ty_incap_bot G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot ∶icp typ_nocap

| ty_incap_typ G e A S T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S T)
     ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S T)

| ty_incap_cap G e M S T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap M) S T)
     ∶icp typ_top

| ty_incap_met G e m TC TZ TR:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR) ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR)

| ty_incap_fld G e a T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2) ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2)

| ty_incap_sel G e x B y S T T':
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ B S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (open y T) ∶icp T' ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) B (avar_f y) ∶icp T'

| ty_incap_rec G e T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bnd T ∶icp typ_bnd T

| ty_incap_and G e S1 T1 S2 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ S1 ∶icp S2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 ∶icp T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and S1 T1 ∶icp typ_and S2 T2

| ty_incap_or G e S1 T1 S2 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ S1 ∶icp S2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 ∶icp T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_or S1 T1 ∶icp typ_or S2 T2

| ty_incap_fun G e S T:
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_fun S T ∶icp typ_fun S T

| ty_incap_nocap G e T:
    mode_incap' typing_mode = mode_incap_nocap ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T ∶icp T
.

Global Existing Instance ty_var.

Global Existing Instance subtyp.

Global Existing Instance ty_incap.

Inductive ty_capbnd (C : typ_refcap_label) : CapabilityBound C :=
| ty_capbnd_top G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

| ty_capbnd_bot G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_bot

| ty_capbnd_typ G e A S T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S T) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

| ty_capbnd_cap_sel G e S T:

    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap C) S T) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ T

| ty_capbnd_cap_ignore G e C' S T:
    C' <> C ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap C') S T) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

| ty_capbnd_met G e m TC TZ TR:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

| ty_capbnd_fld G e a T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

| ty_capbnd_sel G e x B y S T T':
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ B S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (open y T) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ T' ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) B (avar_f y) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ T'

| ty_capbnd_rec G e T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bnd T ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

| ty_capbnd_and G e S1 T1 S2 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ S1 ∶cpb⟦C⟧ S2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 ∶cpb⟦C⟧ T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and S1 T1 ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_and S2 T2

| ty_capbnd_or G e S1 T1 S2 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ S1 ∶cpb⟦C⟧ S2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 ∶cpb⟦C⟧ T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_or S1 T1 ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_or S2 T2

| ty_capbnd_all G e S T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_fun S T ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

.

Global Existing Instance ty_capbnd.

Inductive viewpoint_adapt_cap: typ_refcap_label -> var -> (TypingProperty typ typ) :=
| viewpoint_adapt_cap_strip_combine C x G Go e T Tstrip Tcap:
    G§§Go⁏e ⊢ T ∶icp Tstrip ->
    G§§Go⁏e ⊢ T ∶cpb⟦C⟧ Tcap ->
    viewpoint_adapt_cap C x G Go e T (typ_and Tstrip (typ_cap_adapt C x Tcap)).

Definition viewpoint_adapt x G Go e Tf Tr :=
  match (mode_viewpoint_adaptation' typing_mode) with

  | mode_viewpoint_adaptation_same => Tf = Tr

  | mode_viewpoint_adapt_mutability => viewpoint_adapt_cap typ_refcap_mutability x G Go e Tf Tr
  end.

End WithTypingMode.

Notation "G ⁏ e ⊢ x ▷⟦ C ⟧ T1 ⟶ T2" :=
  (viewpoint_adapt_cap _ C x G objctx_empty e T1 T2)
    (at level 40, e at level 39, x at level 59, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation "G ⁏ e ⊢ x ▷ T1 ⟶ T2" :=
  (viewpoint_adapt _ x G objctx_empty e T1 T2)
    (at level 40, e at level 39, x at level 59, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation typ_objlit typing_mode T := (
  match (mode_objlit_refcaps' typing_mode) with

  | mode_objlit_refcaps_none => typ_and (typ_bnd T) typ_top

  | mode_objlit_refcaps_mutable => typ_and (typ_bnd T) (typ_mut_marker typ_bot)
  end) (only parsing).

Notation vis_var typing_mode G x := (
  (mode_has_visibility typing_mode) -> (ctx_vis G x)
  ) (only parsing).

Notation mut_var_writeable typing_mode G e x := (
  (mode_has_mutability typing_mode) -> (G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) )
  ) (only parsing).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive ty_trm : Typing trm :=

| ty_trm_var : forall G e x T,
    vis_var typing_mode G x ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T

| ty_trm_apply : forall G e x z S T,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    vis_var typing_mode G x ->
    vis_var typing_mode G z ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_fun S T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ z ∶ S ->
    G⁏e ⊢ trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ∶ open z T

| ty_trm_read : forall G e x a S T U,
    vis_var typing_mode G x ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ▷ T ⟶ U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ trm_read (avar_f x) a ∶ U

| ty_trm_write : forall G e x y a S T,
    vis_var typing_mode G x ->
    vis_var typing_mode G y ->
    mut_var_writeable typing_mode G e x ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ y ∶ S ->
    G⁏e ⊢ trm_write (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ T

| ty_trm_call : forall G e x y m TC TZ TR,
    vis_var typing_mode G x ->
    vis_var typing_mode G y ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ y ∶ TZ ->
    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ (open y TC) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ∶ open_met y x TR

| ty_trm_let : forall L G e t u T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G § x / v_let ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x u ∶ U) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ trm_let t u ∶ U

| ty_trm_lit : forall L G e l u T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ l ∶ T ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G § x / v_let ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x u ∶ U) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ trm_lit l u ∶ U

| ty_trm_sub : forall G e (t : trm) T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ t ∶ U

with ty_lit : Typing lit :=

| ty_lit_fun : forall L G e T t U,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G § x / v_par ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ open x U) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ lit_fun T t ∶ typ_fun T U

| ty_lit_obj : forall L G e T ds,
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G §§ (objctx_lit x T) ⁏e ⊢ (open x ds) ∶ (open x T)) ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ lit_obj T ds ∶ typ_objlit typing_mode T

with ty_def : DecTyping def :=

| ty_def_typ : forall L G Go e A T U,
    (forall x, x \notin L -> e ⊢ (open x T) ≈ (open x U)) ->
    G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ def_typ (typ_label_normal A) T ∶d dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) U U

| ty_def_fld : forall G Go e a t T,
    vis_var typing_mode (G §§& Go) t ->
    G §§& Go⁏e ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ def_fld a (avar_f t) ∶d dec_fld a T T

| ty_def_met : forall L G Go e m t TC TZ TR,
    (forall xz, xz \notin L ->
    forall xc, xc <> xz -> xc \notin L ->
    ctx_obj_met typing_mode G Go xz TZ xc TC ⁏e ⊢ open_met xz xc t ∶ open_met xz xc TR) ->
    G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ def_met m t ∶d dec_met m TC TZ TR

with ty_defs: Typing defs :=

| ty_defs_one : forall G Go e d D,
    G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ d ∶d D ->
    G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ defs_cons defs_nil d ∶ typ_rcd D

| ty_defs_cons : forall G Go e ds d T D,
    G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ T ->
    G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ d ∶d D ->
    defs_hasnt ds (label_of d) ->
    G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ defs_cons ds d ∶ typ_and T (typ_rcd D)
.

Global Existing Instance ty_trm | 0.

Global Existing Instance ty_def | 0.

Global Existing Instance ty_lit | 1.

Global Existing Instance ty_defs | 1.

Scheme ts_ty_var_mut := Induction for ty_var Sort Prop
with   ts_subtyp     := Induction for subtyp Sort Prop
with   ts_ty_incap   := Induction for ty_incap Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme ts_mutind from ts_ty_var_mut, ts_subtyp, ts_ty_incap.

Scheme rules_trm_mut    := Induction for ty_trm Sort Prop
with   rules_lit_mut    := Induction for ty_lit Sort Prop
with   rules_def_mut    := Induction for ty_def Sort Prop
with   rules_defs_mut   := Induction for ty_defs Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme rules_mutind from rules_trm_mut, rules_lit_mut,
rules_def_mut, rules_defs_mut.

End WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Notation SubtypingPropery := (ctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop) (only parsing).

Module GeneralizedSubtyping.

Class AndOrSubtyping (ST: SubtypingPropery) := {
  and11 G e T U: ST G e (typ_and T U) T;
  and12 G e T U: ST G e (typ_and T U) U;
  and2 G e S T U:
    ST G e S T ->
    ST G e S U ->
    ST G e S (typ_and T U);
  or11 G e T U: ST G e T (typ_or T U);
  or12 G e T U: ST G e U (typ_or T U);
  or2 G e S T U:
    ST G e S T ->
    ST G e U T ->
    ST G e (typ_or S U) T;
  trans G e S T U:
    ST G e S T ->
    ST G e T U ->
    ST G e S U;
}.

End GeneralizedSubtyping.

Section GeneralizedSubtypingLemmata.

Context {ST} {AOS: GeneralizedSubtyping.AndOrSubtyping ST}.

End GeneralizedSubtypingLemmata.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Global Instance and_or_subtyp: GeneralizedSubtyping.AndOrSubtyping (fun G => (subtyping)  G objctx_empty) := {
  and11 := subtyp_and11 typing_mode;
  and12 := subtyp_and12 typing_mode;
  and2 := @subtyp_and2 typing_mode;
  or11 := subtyp_or11 typing_mode;
  or12 := subtyp_or12 typing_mode;
  or2 := @subtyp_or2 typing_mode;
  trans := @subtyp_trans typing_mode;
}.

End WithTypingMode.

Fixpoint ctx_concat(G1 G2: ctx): ctx :=
match G2 with
| ctx_empty => G1
| ctx_push c v vk t => ctx_push (ctx_concat G1 c) v vk t
| ctx_stop c => ctx_stop (ctx_concat G1 c)
| ctx_hide c => ctx_hide (ctx_concat G1 c)

| ctx_stop G1 => ctx_stop (ctx_map fn G1)
| ctx_hide G1 => ctx_hide (ctx_map fn G1)
end.

| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push G1 v vk t => (fn t) \u (ctx_collect_values fn G1)

| ctx_hide G1 => (ctx_collect_values fn G1)

Instance CtxFreeVar : FreeVar ctx := ctx_fv.

Fixpoint ctx_keys(G: ctx): list var :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => nil
| ctx_push G v vk t =>  v :: (ctx_keys G)
| ctx_stop G => ctx_keys G
| ctx_hide G => ctx_keys G
end.

Fixpoint ctx_dom(G: ctx): fset var :=

| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push G v vk t =>  \{ v } \u (ctx_dom G)
| ctx_stop G => ctx_dom G

| ctx_ok_empty:
  ctx_ok ctx_empty
| ctx_ok_push(G: ctx)(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ):
  ctx_ok G ->

  ctx_ok (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_ok_stop(G: ctx):

| ctx_ok_hide(G: ctx):

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Labels TransformCollect.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_or   : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sel  : avar -> typ_label -> avar -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_fun  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_nocap: typ

with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ: typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_fld: fld_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_met: met_label ->  typ -> typ -> typ -> dec
.

Notation typ_cap_marker C T := (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap C) typ_bot T)) (only parsing).

Notation typ_mut_marker T := (typ_cap_marker typ_refcap_mutability T) (only parsing).

Scheme typ_mut  := Induction for typ Sort Prop
with   dec_mut  := Induction for dec Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme typ_mutind from typ_mut, dec_mut.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (open_rec k u x) L (open_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
                            (open_rec_typ (S k) u U)
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
    dec_met m (open_rec_typ (S k) u TC) (open_rec_typ k u TZ) (open_rec_typ (S (S k)) u TR)
  end.

Instance TypOpenable : Openable typ := open_rec_typ.

Instance DecOpenable : Openable dec := open_rec_dec.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => (fv_dec D)
  | typ_and T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_or T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_sel x L y   => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  | typ_bnd T      => (fv_typ T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | typ_nocap => \{}
  end with
fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_fld m T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => (fv_typ TC) \u (fv_typ TZ) \u (fv_typ TR)
  end.

Instance TypFreeVar : FreeVar typ := fv_typ.

Instance DecFreeVar : FreeVar dec := fv_dec.

Fixpoint subst_typ (z: var) (u: var) (T: typ) { struct T } : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (subst_dec z u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y    => typ_sel (subst_var z u x) L (subst_var z u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (subst_typ z u T)
  | typ_fun T U    => typ_fun (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
subst_dec (z: var) (u: var) (D: dec) { struct D } : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | dec_fld L T U => dec_fld L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => dec_met m (subst_typ z u TC) (subst_typ z u TZ) (subst_typ z u TR)
  end.

Instance TypSubstVar : SubstVar typ := subst_typ.

Instance DecSubstVar : SubstVar dec := subst_dec.

Fixpoint seal_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (seal_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (seal_rec k u x) L (seal_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
seal_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T)
                            (seal_rec_typ (S k) u U)
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (seal_rec_typ k u T)
                            (seal_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
    dec_met m (seal_rec_typ (S k) u TC) (seal_rec_typ k u TZ) (seal_rec_typ (S (S k)) u TR)
  end.

Instance TypSealable : Sealable typ := seal_rec_typ.

Instance DecSealable : Sealable dec := seal_rec_dec.

Instance TypAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax TypOpenable TypFreeVar TypSubstVar := {}.

Instance DecAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax DecOpenable DecFreeVar DecSubstVar := {}.

Instance DecLabelOf : LabelOf dec :=
  fun D =>
      match D with
      | dec_typ L _ _ => label_typ L
      | dec_fld m _ _ => label_fld m
      | dec_met m _ _ _ => label_met m
      end.

Fixpoint collect_typ {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (T: typ) : C :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => df
  | typ_bot        => df
  | typ_rcd D      => (collect_dec df f comb D)
  | typ_and T U    => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | typ_or T U    => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | typ_sel x L y    => comb (f x) (f y)
  | typ_bnd T      => (collect_typ df f comb T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => comb (collect_typ df f comb T1) (collect_typ df f comb T2)
  | typ_nocap => df
  end with
collect_dec {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (D: dec) : C :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | dec_fld m T U => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => comb (comb (collect_typ df f comb TC) (collect_typ df f comb TZ)) (collect_typ df f comb TR)
  end.

Instance TypCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax TypAbstractSyntax
  := @collect_typ.

Instance DecCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax DecAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_dec.

Fixpoint transform_typ (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (T : typ) (n : nat) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (transform_dec f D n)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (transform_typ f T1 n) (transform_typ f T2 n)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (transform_typ f T1 n) (transform_typ f T2 n)
  | typ_sel x L y    => typ_sel (f x n) L (f y n)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (transform_typ f T (S n))
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (transform_typ f T1 n) (transform_typ f T2 (S n))
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
transform_dec (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (D : dec) (n : nat) : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (transform_typ f T (S n)) (transform_typ f U (S n))
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (transform_typ f T n) (transform_typ f U n)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => dec_met m (transform_typ f TC (S n)) (transform_typ f TZ n) (transform_typ f TR (S (S n)))
  end.

Instance TypTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax TypAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_typ.

Instance DecTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax DecAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_dec.

Inductive typ_nulary: typ -> Prop :=
| typ_nulary_top: typ_nulary typ_top
| typ_nulary_bot: typ_nulary typ_bot
| typ_nulary_nocap: typ_nulary typ_nocap
.

Inductive typ_andor: (typ -> typ -> typ) -> Prop :=
| typ_andor_and: typ_andor typ_and
| typ_andor_or: typ_andor typ_or
.

Notation typ_binary_rcd_typ_ctor A :=
  (fun t1 t2 => typ_rcd (dec_typ A t1 t2)).

Notation typ_binary_rcd_fld_ctor A :=
  (fun t1 t2 => typ_rcd (dec_fld A t1 t2)).

Inductive typ_binary: (typ -> typ -> typ) -> Prop :=
| typ_binary_and: typ_binary typ_and
| typ_binary_or: typ_binary typ_or
| typ_binary_fun: typ_binary typ_fun
| typ_binary_rcd_typ(A: typ_label): typ_binary (typ_binary_rcd_typ_ctor A)
| typ_binary_rcd_fld(A: fld_label): typ_binary (typ_binary_rcd_fld_ctor A)
.

Notation typ_notor B := (forall T U, B <> typ_or T U) (only parsing).

Notation typ_notand T := (forall S1 S2, T <> typ_and S1 S2) (only parsing).

Definition typ_notlog T := typ_notor T /\ typ_notand T.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Labels TransformCollect Types.

Inductive trm : Set :=
  | trm_var  : avar -> trm
  | trm_read  : avar -> fld_label -> trm
  | trm_apply  : avar -> avar -> trm
  | trm_let  : trm -> trm -> trm
  | trm_lit  : lit -> trm -> trm
  | trm_write  : avar -> fld_label -> avar -> trm
  | trm_call: avar -> met_label -> avar -> trm

with lit : Set :=
  | lit_fun : typ -> trm -> lit
  | lit_obj  : typ -> defs -> lit

with def : Set :=
  | def_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> def
  | def_fld  : fld_label -> avar -> def
  | def_met  : met_label -> trm -> def

with defs : Set :=
  | defs_nil : defs
  | defs_cons : defs -> def -> defs.

Scheme trm_mut  := Induction for trm  Sort Prop
with   lit_mut  := Induction for lit  Sort Prop
with   def_mut  := Induction for def  Sort Prop
with   defs_mut := Induction for defs Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme trm_mutind from trm_mut, lit_mut, def_mut, defs_mut.

Fixpoint open_rec_trm (k: nat) (u: var) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a      => trm_var (open_rec k u a)
  | trm_read v m    => trm_read (open_rec k u v) m
  | trm_apply f a    => trm_apply (open_rec k u f) (open_rec k u a)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (open_rec_trm k u t1) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t2)
  | trm_lit l t => trm_lit (open_rec_lit k u l) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | trm_write v m v2 => trm_write (open_rec k u v) m (open_rec k u v2)
  | trm_call v m v2 => trm_call (open_rec k u v) m (open_rec k u v2)
  end with
open_rec_lit (k: nat) (u: var) (l: lit): lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t => lit_fun (open_rec k u T) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | lit_obj T ds =>
    lit_obj
      (open_rec (S k) u T)
      (open_rec_defs (S k) u ds)

  end with
open_rec_def (k: nat) (u: var) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (open_rec (S k) u T)
  | def_fld m v => def_fld m (open_rec k u v)
  | def_met m e => def_met m (open_rec_trm (S (S k)) u e)
  end with
open_rec_defs (k: nat) (u: var) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil       => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (open_rec_defs k u tl) (open_rec_def k u d)
  end.

Instance TrmOpenable : Openable trm := open_rec_trm.

Instance LitOpenable : Openable lit := open_rec_lit.

Instance DefOpenable : Openable def := open_rec_def.

Instance DefsOpenable : Openable defs := open_rec_defs.

Fixpoint fv_trm (t: trm) : vars :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a         => (fv a)
  | trm_read x m       => (fv x)
  | trm_apply f a       => (fv f) \u (fv a)
  | trm_let t1 t2     => (fv_trm t1) \u (fv_trm t2)
  | trm_lit l t       => (fv_lit l) \u (fv_trm t)
  | trm_write x m y     => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  | trm_call x m y => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  end with
fv_lit (l: lit) : vars :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T e    => (fv T) \u (fv_trm e)
  | lit_obj T ds => (fv T) \u (fv_defs ds)
  end with
fv_def (d: def) : vars :=
  match d with
  | def_typ _ T     => (fv T)
  | def_fld _ v     => (fv v)
  | def_met _ t     => (fv_trm t)
  end with
fv_defs(ds: defs) : vars :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil         => \{}
  | defs_cons tl d   => (fv_defs tl) \u (fv_def d)
  end.

Instance TrmFreeVar : FreeVar trm := fv_trm.

Instance LitFreeVar : FreeVar lit := fv_lit.

Instance DefFreeVar : FreeVar def := fv_def.

Instance DefsFreeVar : FreeVar defs := fv_defs.

Fixpoint subst_trm (z: var) (u: var) (t: trm) : trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var x        => trm_var (subst_var z u x)
  | trm_read x1 L     => trm_read (subst_var z u x1) L
  | trm_apply x1 x2    => trm_apply (subst_var z u x1) (subst_var z u x2)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => trm_let (subst_trm z u t1) (subst_trm z u t2)
  | trm_lit l t      => trm_lit (subst_lit z u l) (subst_trm z u t)
  | trm_write x1 L x2  => trm_write (subst_var z u x1) L (subst_var z u x2)
  | trm_call x1 L x2  => trm_call (subst_var z u x1) L (subst_var z u x2)
  end with
subst_lit (z: var) (u: var) (l: lit) : lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t   => lit_fun (subst_var z u T) (subst_trm z u t)
  | lit_obj T ds =>
    lit_obj (subst_var z u T)
            (subst_defs z u ds)
  end with
subst_def (z: var) (u: var) (d: def) : def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ l t => def_typ l (subst_var z u t)
  | def_fld l v => def_fld l (subst_var z u v)
  | def_met l t => def_met l (subst_trm z u t)
  end with
subst_defs (z: var) (u: var) (ds: defs) : defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons rest d => defs_cons (subst_defs z u rest) (subst_def z u d)
  end.

Instance TrmSubstVar : SubstVar trm := subst_trm.

Instance LitSubstVar : SubstVar lit := subst_lit.

Instance DefSubstVar : SubstVar def := subst_def.

Instance DefsSubstVar : SubstVar defs := subst_defs.

Fixpoint seal_rec_trm (k: nat) (u: var) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a      => trm_var (seal_rec k u a)
  | trm_read v m    => trm_read (seal_rec k u v) m
  | trm_apply f a    => trm_apply (seal_rec k u f) (seal_rec k u a)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (seal_rec_trm k u t1) (seal_rec_trm (S k) u t2)
  | trm_lit l t => trm_lit (seal_rec_lit k u l) (seal_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | trm_write v m v2 => trm_write (seal_rec k u v) m (seal_rec k u v2)
  | trm_call v m v2 => trm_call (seal_rec k u v) m (seal_rec k u v2)
  end with
seal_rec_lit (k: nat) (u: var) (l: lit): lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t => lit_fun (seal_rec k u T) (seal_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | lit_obj T ds =>
    lit_obj
      (seal_rec (S k) u T)
      (seal_rec_defs (S k) u ds)

  end with
seal_rec_def (k: nat) (u: var) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (seal_rec (S k) u T)
  | def_fld m v => def_fld m (seal_rec k u v)
  | def_met m e => def_met m (seal_rec_trm (S (S k)) u e)
  end with
seal_rec_defs (k: nat) (u: var) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil       => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (seal_rec_defs k u tl) (seal_rec_def k u d)
  end.

Instance TrmSealable : Sealable trm := seal_rec_trm.

Instance LitSealable : Sealable lit := seal_rec_lit.

Instance DefSealable : Sealable def := seal_rec_def.

Instance DefsSealable : Sealable defs := seal_rec_defs.

Instance TrmAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax TrmOpenable TrmFreeVar TrmSubstVar := {}.

Instance LitAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax LitOpenable LitFreeVar LitSubstVar := {}.

Instance DefAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax DefOpenable DefFreeVar DefSubstVar := {}.

Instance DefsAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax DefsOpenable DefsFreeVar DefsSubstVar := {}.

Instance DefLabelOf : LabelOf def :=
  fun D =>
      match D with
      | def_typ L _ => label_typ L
      | def_fld m _ => label_fld m
      | def_met m _ => label_met m
      end.

Fixpoint collect_trm {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (t: trm) : C :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a       => (f a)
  | trm_read x m      => (f x)
  | trm_apply f' a      => comb (f f') (f a)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => comb (collect_trm df f comb t1) (collect_trm df f comb t2)
  | trm_lit l t      => comb (collect_lit df f comb l) (collect_trm df f comb t)
  | trm_write x m y    => comb (f x) (f y)
  | trm_call x m y    => comb (f x) (f y)
  end with
collect_lit {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (l: lit) : C :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T e  => comb (collect df f comb T) (collect_trm df f comb e)
  | lit_obj T ds => comb (collect df f comb T) (collect_defs df f comb ds)
  end with
collect_def {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (d: def) : C :=
  match d with
  | def_typ _ T     => (collect df f comb T)
  | def_fld _ v     => (f v)
  | def_met _ t     => (collect_trm df f comb t)
  end with
collect_defs {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (ds : defs) : C  :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil         => df
  | defs_cons tl d   => comb (collect_defs df f comb tl) (collect_def df f comb d)
  end.

Instance TrmCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax TrmAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_trm.

Instance LitCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax LitAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_lit.

Instance DefCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax DefAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_def.

Instance DefsCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax DefsAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_defs.

Fixpoint transform_trm (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (t : trm) (n : nat) : trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a      => trm_var (f a n)
  | trm_read v m    => trm_read (f v n) m
  | trm_apply f' a    => trm_apply (f f' n) (f a n)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (transform_trm f t1 n) (transform_trm f t2 (S n))
  | trm_lit l t    => trm_lit (transform_lit f l n) (transform_trm f t (S n))
  | trm_write v m v2 => trm_write (f v n) m (f v2 n)
  | trm_call v m v2 => trm_call (f v n) m (f v2 n)
  end with
transform_lit (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (l : lit) (n : nat) : lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t => lit_fun (transform f T n) (transform_trm f t (S n))
  | lit_obj T ds =>
    lit_obj
      (transform f T (S n))
      (transform_defs f ds (S n))
  end with
transform_def (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (d : def) (n : nat) : def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (transform f T (S n))
  | def_fld m e => def_fld m (f e n)
  | def_met m e => def_met m (transform_trm f e (S (S n)))
  end with
transform_defs (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (ds : defs) (n : nat) : defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil       => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (transform_defs f tl n) (transform_def f d n)
  end.

Instance TrmTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax TrmAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_trm.

Instance LitTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax LitAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_lit.

Instance DefTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax DefAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_def.

Instance DefsTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax DefsAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_defs.

Require Import LibExtra Vars Terms Stack Heap Env SyntaxClasses.

Inductive config: Type := config_mk (t:trm) (s:stack) (S:heap) (e:renv) (Lv: fset var): config.

Notation "t ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv" :=
  (config_mk t s Sigma e Lv) (at level 39, s, Sigma, e at level 38, Lv at level 38) : syntax_scope.

Definition config_heap C := (
  match C with
  _ ; _ ; Sc ; _ ; _ => Sc

Definition config_env C := (

  _ ; _ ; _ ; e ; _ => e

Definition config_fv C := (

  _ ; _ ; _ ; _ ; Lv => Lv

Notation fv_renv e := ((@dom var e) \u (fv_env e)).

Notation fv_config c :=
  match c with
  | (t ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) =>

Class TypingEquiv (A : Set) := typing_equiv : renv -> A -> A -> Prop.

Notation "e ⊢ a '≈' b" := (typing_equiv e a b) (at level 40, a at level 59).

Inductive tyq_var: TypingEquiv var :=
| tyq_var_refl(e: renv)(v: var):
  typing_equiv e v v
| tyq_var_binds(e: renv)(v1 v2: var):
  renv_binds v1 v2 e ->
  typing_equiv e v1 v2
| tyq_var_sym(e: renv)(v1 v2: var):
  typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  typing_equiv e v2 v1
| tyq_var_trans(e: renv)(v1 v2 v3: var):
  typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  typing_equiv e v2 v3 ->
  typing_equiv e v1 v3
.

Existing Instance tyq_var.

Inductive tyq_typ: TypingEquiv typ :=
| tyq_typ_nulary(e: renv) T:
  typ_nulary T ->
    typing_equiv e T T
| tyq_typ_andor T (e: renv) t11 t12 t21 t22:
  typ_andor T ->
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    typing_equiv e (T t11 t12) (T t21 t22)
| tyq_typ_fun (e: renv) t11 t12 t21 t22:
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t12) (open x t22)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_fun t11 t12) (typ_fun t21 t22)
| tyq_typ_fld (e: renv) a t11 t12 t21 t22:
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t11 t12)) (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t21 t22))
| tyq_typ_typ (e: renv) B t11 t12 t21 t22:
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t11) (open x t21)) ->
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t12) (open x t22)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_typ B t11 t12)) (typ_rcd (dec_typ B t21 t22))
| tyq_typ_sel_normal(e: renv)(v1 v2: var) (v3: avar)(l: typ_normal_label):
    typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_sel (avar_f v1) (typ_label_normal l) v3) (typ_sel (avar_f v2) (typ_label_normal l) v3)
| tyq_typ_sel(e: renv)(v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_label):
    typing_equiv e (typ_sel v1 l v2) (typ_sel v1 l v2)
| tyq_typ_bnd(e: renv)(t1 t2: typ):
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t1) (open x t2)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_bnd t1) (typ_bnd t2)
| tyq_typ_met m (e: renv) t11 t12 t13 t21 t22 t23:
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t11) (open x t21)) ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    (forall x y, typing_equiv e (open_met x y t13) (open_met x y t23)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_met m t11 t12 t13)) (typ_rcd (dec_met m t21 t22 t23))
.

Existing Instance tyq_typ.

Inductive tyq_var_alt: renv -> var -> var -> Prop :=
| tyq_var_alt_eq e v:
    tyq_var_alt e v v
| tyq_var_alt_wy e w y:
    binds w y e ->
    tyq_var_alt e w y
| tyq_var_alt_yw e w y:
    binds w y e ->
    tyq_var_alt e y w
| tyq_var_alt_ww e w1 w2 y:
    binds w1 y e ->
    binds w2 y e ->
    tyq_var_alt e w1 w2.

Inductive typ_indep: avar -> typ -> Prop :=
| typ_indep_nulary v T:
  typ_nulary T -> typ_indep v T

| typ_indep_and v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_and t1 t2)
| typ_indep_or v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_or t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fld v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_f v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_b n a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_fun_f v t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fun_b n t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_sel(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_label):
    v <> v1 ->
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 l v2)
| typ_indep_sel_normal(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_normal_label):
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 (typ_label_normal l) v2)
| typ_indep_bnd_f v t:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_bnd_b n t:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_met_f v t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
| typ_indep_met_b n t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S (S n))) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
.

Notation typ_indep_f v T := (typ_indep (avar_f v) T).

Notation typ_indep_b n T := (typ_indep (avar_b n) T).

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Labels TransformCollect.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_or   : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sel  : avar -> typ_label -> avar -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_fun  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_nocap: typ

with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ: typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_fld: fld_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_met: met_label ->  typ -> typ -> typ -> dec
.

Notation typ_cap_marker C T := (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap C) typ_bot T)) (only parsing).

Notation typ_mut_marker T := (typ_cap_marker typ_refcap_mutability T) (only parsing).

Scheme typ_mut  := Induction for typ Sort Prop
with   dec_mut  := Induction for dec Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme typ_mutind from typ_mut, dec_mut.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (open_rec k u x) L (open_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
                            (open_rec_typ (S k) u U)
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
    dec_met m (open_rec_typ (S k) u TC) (open_rec_typ k u TZ) (open_rec_typ (S (S k)) u TR)
  end.

Instance TypOpenable : Openable typ := open_rec_typ.

Instance DecOpenable : Openable dec := open_rec_dec.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => (fv_dec D)
  | typ_and T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_or T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_sel x L y   => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  | typ_bnd T      => (fv_typ T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | typ_nocap => \{}
  end with
fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_fld m T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => (fv_typ TC) \u (fv_typ TZ) \u (fv_typ TR)
  end.

Instance TypFreeVar : FreeVar typ := fv_typ.

Instance DecFreeVar : FreeVar dec := fv_dec.

Fixpoint subst_typ (z: var) (u: var) (T: typ) { struct T } : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (subst_dec z u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y    => typ_sel (subst_var z u x) L (subst_var z u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (subst_typ z u T)
  | typ_fun T U    => typ_fun (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
subst_dec (z: var) (u: var) (D: dec) { struct D } : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | dec_fld L T U => dec_fld L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => dec_met m (subst_typ z u TC) (subst_typ z u TZ) (subst_typ z u TR)
  end.

Instance TypSubstVar : SubstVar typ := subst_typ.

Instance DecSubstVar : SubstVar dec := subst_dec.

Fixpoint seal_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (seal_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (seal_rec k u x) L (seal_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
seal_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T)
                            (seal_rec_typ (S k) u U)
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (seal_rec_typ k u T)
                            (seal_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
    dec_met m (seal_rec_typ (S k) u TC) (seal_rec_typ k u TZ) (seal_rec_typ (S (S k)) u TR)
  end.

Instance TypSealable : Sealable typ := seal_rec_typ.

Instance DecSealable : Sealable dec := seal_rec_dec.

Instance TypAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax TypOpenable TypFreeVar TypSubstVar := {}.

Instance DecAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax DecOpenable DecFreeVar DecSubstVar := {}.

Instance DecLabelOf : LabelOf dec :=
  fun D =>
      match D with
      | dec_typ L _ _ => label_typ L
      | dec_fld m _ _ => label_fld m
      | dec_met m _ _ _ => label_met m
      end.

Fixpoint collect_typ {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (T: typ) : C :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => df
  | typ_bot        => df
  | typ_rcd D      => (collect_dec df f comb D)
  | typ_and T U    => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | typ_or T U    => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | typ_sel x L y    => comb (f x) (f y)
  | typ_bnd T      => (collect_typ df f comb T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => comb (collect_typ df f comb T1) (collect_typ df f comb T2)
  | typ_nocap => df
  end with
collect_dec {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (D: dec) : C :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | dec_fld m T U => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => comb (comb (collect_typ df f comb TC) (collect_typ df f comb TZ)) (collect_typ df f comb TR)
  end.

Instance TypCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax TypAbstractSyntax
  := @collect_typ.

Instance DecCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax DecAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_dec.

Fixpoint transform_typ (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (T : typ) (n : nat) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (transform_dec f D n)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (transform_typ f T1 n) (transform_typ f T2 n)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (transform_typ f T1 n) (transform_typ f T2 n)
  | typ_sel x L y    => typ_sel (f x n) L (f y n)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (transform_typ f T (S n))
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (transform_typ f T1 n) (transform_typ f T2 (S n))
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
transform_dec (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (D : dec) (n : nat) : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (transform_typ f T (S n)) (transform_typ f U (S n))
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (transform_typ f T n) (transform_typ f U n)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => dec_met m (transform_typ f TC (S n)) (transform_typ f TZ n) (transform_typ f TR (S (S n)))
  end.

Instance TypTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax TypAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_typ.

Instance DecTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax DecAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_dec.

Inductive typ_nulary: typ -> Prop :=
| typ_nulary_top: typ_nulary typ_top
| typ_nulary_bot: typ_nulary typ_bot
| typ_nulary_nocap: typ_nulary typ_nocap
.

Inductive typ_andor: (typ -> typ -> typ) -> Prop :=
| typ_andor_and: typ_andor typ_and

Notation typ_binary_rcd_typ_ctor A :=

Notation typ_binary_rcd_fld_ctor A :=

Inductive typ_binary: (typ -> typ -> typ) -> Prop :=
| typ_binary_and: typ_binary typ_and
| typ_binary_or: typ_binary typ_or
| typ_binary_fun: typ_binary typ_fun
| typ_binary_rcd_typ(A: typ_label): typ_binary (typ_binary_rcd_typ_ctor A)
| typ_binary_rcd_fld(A: fld_label): typ_binary (typ_binary_rcd_fld_ctor A)
.

Notation typ_notor B := (forall T U, B <> typ_or T U) (only parsing).

Notation typ_notand T := (forall S1 S2, T <> typ_and S1 S2) (only parsing).

Definition typ_notlog T := typ_notor T /\ typ_notand T.

Inductive record_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| rd_typ : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T T)
| rd_typb : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) typ_bot T)
| rd_fld : forall a T, record_dec (dec_fld a T T)
| rd_met : forall m TC TZ TR, record_dec (dec_met m TC TZ TR)
.

Inductive record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
| rt_one : forall D l,
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
| rt_cons: forall T ls D l,
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  l \notin ls ->
  record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition record_type T := exists ls, record_typ T ls.

Inductive refcap_dec: dec -> Prop :=
  | refcap_dec_typb lt TU:
    refcap_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap lt) typ_bot TU).

Inductive refcap_typ: typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
  | refcap_typ_top:
      refcap_typ typ_top \{}
  | refcap_typ_one D l:
      refcap_dec D ->
      l = label_of D ->
      refcap_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
  | refcap_typ_cons T ls D l:
      refcap_typ T ls ->
      refcap_dec D ->
      l = label_of D ->
      l \notin ls ->
      refcap_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition refcap_type T := exists ls, refcap_typ T ls.

Inductive record_has: typ -> dec -> Prop :=
| rh_one : forall D,
    record_has (typ_rcd D) D
| rh_andl : forall T U D,
    record_has T D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D
| rh_andr : forall T U D,
    record_has U D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D.

Fixpoint deref_base A (su: SubstVar A) (e: renv) (X: A): A :=

Instance deref_var: Deref var := deref_base VarSubstVar.

Instance deref_def: Deref def :=

match ds with
| defs_nil => defs_nil
| defs_cons ds d => defs_cons (deref_defs_fix e ds) (deref_def e d)
end.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import Stdlib.Init.Sumbool.

Require Import LibExtra.

Generalizable Variables A B.

Declare Scope syntax_scope.

Delimit Scope syntax_scope with S.

Open Scope syntax_scope.

Class Openable (A : Set) := open_rec : nat -> var -> A -> A.

Class FreeVar (A : Set) := fv : A -> vars.

Class SubstVar (A : Set) := subst_var : var -> var -> A -> A.

Bind Scope syntax_scope with Openable FreeVar SubstVar.

Arguments open_rec _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Arguments fv _ _ !_ /.

Arguments subst_var _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Class AbstractSyntax (A : Set) `(Openable A) `(FreeVar A) `(SubstVar A).

Notation "z '/[' x '->' y ']'" :=
  (subst_var x y z) (x at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation subst_vars := (vars_zip_map subst_var) (only parsing).

Notation "z '/[' xs '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (subst_vars xs ys z) (xs at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Definition subst_pvars `{AS: SubstVar A} `{AF: FreeVar A}
  (xs ys: list var) (a: A): A :=
    let (zs, _) := (var_freshes (from_list xs \u from_list ys \u fv a) (length ys))
    in a /[xs --> zs] /[zs --> ys].

Notation "z '//[' xs '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (subst_pvars xs ys z) (xs at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation open := (open_rec 0) (only parsing).

Definition open_depth_rec `{AS : Openable A} n x a d :=
  open_rec (n + d) x a.

Notation open_depth := (open_depth_rec 0).

Arguments open_depth_rec _ _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Definition closed `{AS: Openable A} a :=
  forall n x, open_rec n x a = a.

Fixpoint open_rec_vars `{AS : Openable A} (k: nat) (ys: list var) (X: A): A :=
  match ys with
  | nil => X
  | cons y ys => open_rec_vars (S k) ys (open_rec k y X)
  end.

Notation open_vars := (open_rec_vars 0) (only parsing).

Arguments open_rec_vars _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Notation "z '/[#' n '->' y ']'" :=
  (open_rec n y z) (n at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation "z '/[->' y ']'" :=
  (open y z) (at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation "z '/[#' n '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (open_rec_vars n ys z) (n at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation "z '/[-->' ys ']'" :=
  (open_vars ys z) (at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Class Sealable (A: Set) := seal_rec: nat -> var -> A -> A.

Bind Scope syntax_scope with Sealable.

Arguments seal_rec _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Notation seal := (seal_rec 0).

Definition sealed `{AS: Sealable A} a :=
  forall x, seal x a = a.

Definition seal_depth_rec `{AS: Sealable A} n x a d := seal_rec (n+d) x a.

Arguments seal_depth_rec _ _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Notation "z '/[->>' y ']'" :=
  (seal y z) (at level 7) : syntax_scope.

Notation "z '/[#' n '->>' y ']'" :=
  (seal_rec n y z) (n at level 69, at level 7) : syntax_scope.

Class DecideFv `(AS: AbstractSyntax A) := dec_fv : var -> A -> bool.

Arguments dec_fv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Definition dec_notin_fv `{DFv: DecideFv A} x a := negb (dec_fv x a).

Arguments dec_notin_fv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Class ReflectFv `(DFv: DecideFv A) :=
  reflect_fv : forall x a,
    (x \in fv a) <-> (dec_fv x a) = true.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Strings.String.

Definition typ_normal_label: Set := string.

Definition fld_label: Set := string.

Definition met_label: Set := string.

Inductive typ_refcap_label: Set :=

| typ_refcap_mutability
.

Inductive typ_label: Set :=
| typ_label_normal: typ_normal_label -> typ_label
| typ_label_refcap: typ_refcap_label -> typ_label
.

Notation typ_label_mutability := (typ_label_refcap typ_refcap_mutability) (only parsing).

Inductive label: Set :=
| label_typ: typ_label -> label
| label_fld: fld_label -> label
| label_met: met_label -> label
.

Class LabelOf (A : Set) := label_of : A -> label.

Arguments label_of _ _ !_ /.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import AbstractSyntax.

Class DefsConjunctive (P: defs -> Prop) (Q: def -> Prop) := {

  defs_conj_nil: (P defs_nil) ;
  defs_conj_cons ds d: (P ds) -> (Q d) -> (P (defs_cons ds d)) ;

  defs_conj_cons_def ds d: (P (defs_cons ds d)) -> (Q d) ;
  defs_conj_cons_inv ds d: (P (defs_cons ds d)) -> (P ds)
}.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Inductive avar : Set :=
  | avar_b : nat -> avar
  | avar_f : var -> avar.

Notation avars := (list avar).

Instance VarSubstVar : SubstVar var :=
  fun x y z => If z = x then y else z.

Instance VarSealable: Sealable var :=
  fun n x y => y.

Instance VarOpenable : Openable var :=
  fun n x a => a.

Instance VarFreeVar : FreeVar var := singleton (A:=var).

Instance VarAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax VarOpenable VarFreeVar VarSubstVar := {}.

Instance AvarOpenable : Openable avar :=
  fun n x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => If n = i then avar_f x else avar_b i
    | avar_f y => avar_f y
    end.

Instance AvarFreeVar : FreeVar avar :=
  fun a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => \{}
    | avar_f x => \{x}
    end.

Instance AvarSubstVar : SubstVar avar :=
  fun (x: var) (y: var) (a: avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
    | avar_f z => (avar_f (If z = x then y else z))
    end.

Instance AvarAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax AvarOpenable AvarFreeVar AvarSubstVar := {}.

Instance AvarSealable : Sealable avar :=
  fun n x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => If n <= i then avar_f x else avar_b i
    | avar_f y => avar_f y
    end.

Instance AvarDecideFv : DecideFv AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => false
    | avar_f y => (If x = y then true else false)
    end.

Instance AvarClosing : Closing AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun (n : nat) (x : var) (a : avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
    | avar_f y => (If y = x then avar_b n else avar_f y)
    end.

Section VarSubstVar.

Context `{AS: AbstractSyntax}.

Context {SF: SubstFresh AS}.

Context {FS: FvSubstCases AS}.

Context {SC: SubstCommut AS}.

Context {ASOC: SubstOpenCommut AS}.

Context {SI: SubstId AS}.

End VarSubstVar.

Inductive varkind: Set :=
| v_loc: varkind
| v_ref: varkind
| v_par: varkind
| v_self: varkind
| v_let: varkind
| v_recv: varkind
.

Inductive varkind_abstract: varkind -> Prop :=
| v_abstract_let: varkind_abstract v_let
| v_abstract_par: varkind_abstract v_par
| v_abstract_self: varkind_abstract v_self

                  G §§ objctx_lit x T ⁏ e ⊢ ds /[-> x] ∶ T /[-> x]) ->
                 Indep.typ_indep (avar_b 0) T ->
                 G ⁏ e ⊢ lit_obj T ds
                 ∶ match mode_objlit_refcaps' typing_mode with
                   | mode_objlit_refcaps_none => typ_and (typ_bnd T) typ_top
                   | mode_objlit_refcaps_mutable =>
                       typ_and (typ_bnd T)
                         (typ_rcd
                            (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap typ_refcap_mutability)
                               typ_bot typ_bot))
                   end
  with ty_def (typing_mode : Mode) : DecTyping def :=
    ty_def_typ : forall (L : fset var) (G : ctx) (Go : objctx) 
                   (e : env var) (A : typ_normal_label) 
                   (T U : typ),
                 (forall x : var,
                  x \notin L ->
                  Equivalence.typing_equiv e T /[-> x] U /[-> x]) ->
                 G §§ Go ⁏ e ⊢ def_typ (typ_label_normal A) T
                 ∶d dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) U U
  | ty_def_fld : forall (G : ctx) (Go : objctx) (e : env var) 
                   (a : fld_label) (t : var) (T : typ),
                 (mode_visibility' typing_mode = mode_visibility_hide_method ->
                  ctx_vis (G §§& Go) t) ->
                 G §§& Go ⁏ e ⊢ t ∶ T ->
                 G §§ Go ⁏ e ⊢ def_fld a (avar_f t) ∶d dec_fld a T T
  | ty_def_met : forall (L : fset var) (G : ctx) (Go : objctx) 
                   (e : env var) (m : met_label) (t : trm) 
                   (TC TZ TR : typ),
                 (forall xz : var,
                  xz \notin L ->
                  forall xc : var,
                  xc <> xz ->
                  xc \notin L ->
                  ctx_obj_met typing_mode G Go xz TZ xc TC ⁏ e
                  ⊢ t /[# 1 -> xc] /[-> xz] ∶ TR /[# 1 -> xc] /[-> xz]) ->
                 G §§ Go ⁏ e ⊢ def_met m t ∶d dec_met m TC TZ TR
  with ty_defs (typing_mode : Mode) : Typing defs :=
    ty_defs_one : forall (G : ctx) (Go : objctx) (e : env var) 
                    (d : def) (D : dec),
                  G §§ Go ⁏ e ⊢ d ∶d D ->
                  G §§ Go ⁏ e ⊢ defs_cons defs_nil d ∶ typ_rcd D
  | ty_defs_cons : forall (G : ctx) (Go : objctx) 
                     (e : env var) (ds : defs) (d : def) 
                     (T : typ) (D : dec),
                   G §§ Go ⁏ e ⊢ ds ∶ T ->
                   G §§ Go ⁏ e ⊢ d ∶d D ->
                   defs_hasnt ds (label_of d) ->
                   G §§ Go ⁏ e ⊢ defs_cons ds d ∶ typ_and T (typ_rcd D).

Rocq < Inductive ty_var (typing_mode : Mode) : Typing var :=
    ty_var_var : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (x : var) (T : typ),
                 ctx_binds x T G -> G ⁏ e ⊢ x ∶ T
  | ty_rec_intro : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (x : var) (T : typ),
                   G ⁏ e ⊢ x ∶ T /[-> x] ->
                   Indep.typ_indep (avar_b 0) T ->
                   (mode_has_incap' typing_mode = true ->
                    G ⁏ e ⊢ T /[-> x] ∶icp T /[-> x]) ->
                   G ⁏ e ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T
  | ty_rec_elim : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (x : var) (T : typ),
                  G ⁏ e ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T ->
                  Indep.typ_indep (avar_b 0) T -> G ⁏ e ⊢ x ∶ T /[-> x]
  | ty_var_and : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (x : var) (T U : typ),
                 G ⁏ e ⊢ x ∶ T -> G ⁏ e ⊢ x ∶ U -> G ⁏ e ⊢ x ∶ typ_and T U
  | ty_var_sub : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (x : var) (T U : typ),
                 G ⁏ e ⊢ x ∶ T -> G ⁏ e ⊢ T <: U -> G ⁏ e ⊢ x ∶ U
  | ty_var_mut_top : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (x : var) (T : typ),
                     mode_has_mutability' typing_mode = true ->
                     G ⁏ e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
                     G ⁏ e ⊢ x
                     ∶ typ_rcd
                         (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap typ_refcap_mutability)
                            typ_bot typ_top)
  with subtyp (typing_mode : Mode) : Subtyping :=
    subtyp_top : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (T : typ),
                 G ⁏ e ⊢ T <: typ_top
  | subtyp_bot : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (T : typ),
                 G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_bot <: T
  | subtyp_refl : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (T : typ), G ⁏ e ⊢ T <: T
  | subtyp_trans : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (S T U : typ),
                   G ⁏ e ⊢ S <: T -> G ⁏ e ⊢ T <: U -> G ⁏ e ⊢ S <: U
  | subtyp_and11 : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (T U : typ),
                   G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_and T U <: T
  | subtyp_and12 : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (T U : typ),
                   G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_and T U <: U
  | subtyp_and2 : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (S T U : typ),
                  G ⁏ e ⊢ S <: T ->
                  G ⁏ e ⊢ S <: U -> G ⁏ e ⊢ S <: typ_and T U
  | subtyp_or11 : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (T U : typ),
                  G ⁏ e ⊢ T <: typ_or T U
  | subtyp_or12 : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (T U : typ),
                  G ⁏ e ⊢ U <: typ_or T U
  | subtyp_or2 : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (S T U : typ),
                 G ⁏ e ⊢ S <: T -> G ⁏ e ⊢ U <: T -> G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_or S U <: T
  | subtyp_fld : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (a : fld_label)
                   (T1 T2 U1 U2 : typ),
                 G ⁏ e ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
                 G ⁏ e ⊢ U1 <: U2 ->
                 G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T2 U1) <:
                 typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 U2)
  | subtyp_typ : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (A : typ_label)
                   (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
                 (forall x : var, G ⁏ e ⊢ S2 /[-> x] <: S1 /[-> x]) ->
                 (forall x : var, G ⁏ e ⊢ T1 /[-> x] <: T2 /[-> x]) ->
                 G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) <:
                 typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2)
  | subtyp_sel2 : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (x : var) 
                    (A : typ_label) (y : var) (S T : typ),
                  G ⁏ e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
                  G ⁏ e ⊢ S /[-> y] <: typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)
  | subtyp_sel1 : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (x : var) 
                    (A : typ_label) (y : var) (S T : typ),
                  G ⁏ e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
                  G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y) <: T /[-> y]
  | subtyp_fun : forall (L : fset var) (G : ctx) (e : env var)
                   (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
                 mode_has_fun' typing_mode = true ->
                 G ⁏ e ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
                 (forall x : var,
                  x \notin L -> G §ᶻ x ~ S2 ⁏ e ⊢ T1 /[-> x] <: T2 /[-> x]) ->
                 G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_fun S1 T1 <: typ_fun S2 T2
  | subtyp_met : forall (L : fset var) (G : ctx) (e : env var)
                   (m : met_label) (TC1 TZ1 TR1 TC2 TZ2 TR2 : typ),
                 G ⁏ e ⊢ TZ2 <: TZ1 ->
                 (forall x : var,
                  x \notin L -> G §ᶻ x ~ TZ2 ⁏ e ⊢ TC2 /[-> x] <: TC1 /[-> x]) ->
                 (mode_sef' typing_mode = mode_sef_guarantee ->
                  Indep.typ_indep (avar_b 0) TC2 ->
                  Indep.typ_indep (avar_b 0) TC1) ->
                 (forall x : var,
                  x \notin L ->
                  forall y : var,
                  y <> x ->
                  y \notin L ->
                  ctx_met G x TZ2 y TC2 ⁏ e ⊢ TR1 /[# 1 -> y] /[-> x] <:
                  TR2 /[# 1 -> y] /[-> x]) ->
                 G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC1 TZ1 TR1) <:
                 typ_rcd (dec_met m TC2 TZ2 TR2)
  | subtyp_tyq : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (T1 T2 : typ),
                 Equivalence.typing_equiv e T1 T2 -> G ⁏ e ⊢ T1 <: T2
  | subtyp_typ_and : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) 
                       (A : typ_label) (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
                     G ⁏ e
                     ⊢ typ_and (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))
                         (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2)) <:
                     typ_rcd (dec_typ A (typ_or S1 S2) (typ_and T1 T2))
  | subtyp_dist : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (T1 T2 T3 : typ),
                  G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_and T1 (typ_or T2 T3) <:
                  typ_or (typ_and T1 T2) (typ_and T1 T3)
  | subtyp_nocap_bnd : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (T : typ),
                       G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_bnd T
  | subtyp_nocap_typ : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) 
                         (A : typ_normal_label) (T1 T2 : typ),
                       G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_nocap <:
                       typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T1 T2)
  | subtyp_nocap_fld : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) 
                         (a : fld_label) (T1 T2 : typ),
                       G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2)
  | subtyp_nocap_met : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) 
                         (a : met_label) (TC TZ TR : typ),
                       G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_met a TC TZ TR)
  | subtyp_nocap_fun : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (TZ TR : typ),
                       mode_has_fun' typing_mode = true ->
                       G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_fun TZ TR
  | subtyp_nocap_mut_top_boundless : forall (G : ctx) 
                                       (e : env var) 
                                       (T1 T2 : typ),
                                     mode_top_nm' typing_mode =
                                     mode_top_nm_subtype ->
                                     G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_top <:
                                     typ_or typ_nocap
                                       (typ_rcd
                                          (dec_typ
                                             (typ_label_refcap
                                                typ_refcap_mutability)
                                             T1 T2))
  | subtyp_nocap_mut_top_complement : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var),
                                      mode_top_nm' typing_mode =
                                      mode_top_nm_complement ->
                                      G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_top <:
                                      typ_or typ_nocap
                                        (typ_rcd
                                           (dec_typ
                                              (typ_label_refcap
                                                 typ_refcap_mutability)
                                              typ_bot typ_bot))
  | subtyp_nocap_mut_bot : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var),
                           mode_top_nm' typing_mode = mode_top_nm_complement ->
                           G ⁏ e
                           ⊢ typ_and typ_nocap
                               (typ_rcd
                                  (dec_typ
                                     (typ_label_refcap typ_refcap_mutability)
                                     typ_bot typ_bot)) <:
                           typ_bot
  | subtyp_mut_top : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var),
                     mode_mut_top' typing_mode = mode_mut_top_subtype ->
                     G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_top <:
                     typ_rcd
                       (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap typ_refcap_mutability)
                          typ_bot typ_top)
  with ty_incap (typing_mode : Mode) : ReferenceIncapacitate :=
    ty_incap_top : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var),
                   G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_top ∶icp typ_top
  | ty_incap_bot : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var),
                   G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_bot ∶icp typ_nocap
  | ty_incap_typ : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) 
                     (A : typ_normal_label) (S T : typ),
                   G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S T)
                   ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S T)
  | ty_incap_cap : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) 
                     (M : typ_refcap_label) (S T : typ),
                   G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap M) S T)
                   ∶icp typ_top
  | ty_incap_met : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) 
                     (m : met_label) (TC TZ TR : typ),
                   G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR)
                   ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR)
  | ty_incap_fld : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) 
                     (a : fld_label) (T1 T2 : typ),
                   G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2)
                   ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2)
  | ty_incap_sel : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) 
                     (x : var) (B : typ_label) (y : var) 
                     (S T T' : typ),
                   G ⁏ e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ B S T) ->
                   G ⁏ e ⊢ T /[-> y] ∶icp T' ->
                   G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) B (avar_f y) ∶icp T'
  | ty_incap_rec : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (T : typ),
                   G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_bnd T ∶icp typ_bnd T
  | ty_incap_and : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
                   G ⁏ e ⊢ S1 ∶icp S2 ->
                   G ⁏ e ⊢ T1 ∶icp T2 ->
                   G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_and S1 T1 ∶icp typ_and S2 T2
  | ty_incap_or : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
                  G ⁏ e ⊢ S1 ∶icp S2 ->
                  G ⁏ e ⊢ T1 ∶icp T2 ->
                  G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_or S1 T1 ∶icp typ_or S2 T2
  | ty_incap_fun : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (S T : typ),
                   mode_has_fun' typing_mode = true ->
                   G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_fun S T ∶icp typ_fun S T
  | ty_incap_nocap : forall (G : ctx) (e : env var) (T : typ),
                     mode_incap' typing_mode = mode_incap_nocap ->
                     G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_nocap <: T -> G ⁏ e ⊢ T ∶icp T.

fresh_length
     : forall (L : vars) (n : nat) (xs : list var),
       fresh L n xs -> n = LibList.length xs
ok_empty
     : forall A : Type, ok empty
subset_empty_l
     : forall (A : Type) (E : fset A), \{} \c E
in_singleton_self
     : forall (A : Type) (x : A), x \in \{ x}
binds_empty_inv
     : forall (A : Type) (x : var) (v : A), binds x v empty -> False
fresh =
fix fresh (L : vars) (n : nat) (xs : list var) {struct xs} : Prop :=
  match xs with
  | nil => match n with
           | 0 => True
           | S _ => False
           end
  | (x :: xs')%list =>
      match n with
      | 0 => False
      | S n' => x \notin L /\ fresh (L \u \{ x}) n' xs'
      end
  end
     : vars -> nat -> list var -> Prop

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping.

Lemma executions_from_reachable_progress (C : config) :
  (forall n Cn, C ⊣n↦* Cn -> answer Cn \\/ exists C', Cn ↦ C') ->
  config_terminates C \\/ forall n, exists Cn, C ⊣n↦* Cn.
Proof.
  intros Progress.
  destruct (classic (config_terminates C)) as [Terminates | Diverges].
  - now left.
  - right. induction n as [|n [Cn Steps]].
    + exists C. constructor.
    + destruct (Progress _ _ Steps) as [Answer | [C' Step]].
      * exfalso. apply Diverges. exists n, Cn. auto.
      * exists C'. eapply red_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Section InitialProgress.
Context (typing_mode : Mode).

Lemma empty_context_no_variable G Go e x T :
  @ty_var typing_mode G Go e x T -> G = ctx_empty -> False.
Proof.
  intros Typed.
  induction Typed; intros Empty; try solve [auto].
  subst. inversion H.
Qed.

Lemma empty_context_term_form G Go e t T :
  @ty_trm typing_mode G Go e t T -> G = ctx_empty ->
  (exists t1 t2, t = trm_let t1 t2) \\/ (exists l u, t = trm_lit l u).
Proof.
  intros Typed.
  induction Typed; intros Empty; eauto 6 using empty_context_no_variable.
  all: exfalso; eauto using empty_context_no_variable.
Qed.

Lemma two_fresh_config_vars C :
  exists y w, fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) C /\\ y <> w.
Proof.
  destruct (var_freshes (fv_config C) 2) as [xs Fresh].
  destruct xs as [|y [|w [|z rest]]]; simpl in Fresh; try tauto.
  destruct Fresh as [Hy [Hw _]].
  exists y, w. split.
  - simpl. auto.
  - intros ->. apply Hw. apply in_union_r, in_singleton_self.
Qed.

Lemma initial_configuration_steps t T :
  @ty_trm typing_mode ctx_empty objctx_empty empty t T ->
  forall C, config_initial t C -> exists C', C ↦ C'.
Proof.
  intros Typed C Initial.
  inversion Initial; subst C.
  destruct (empty_context_term_form Typed eq_refl)
    as [[t1 [t2 ->]] | [l [u ->]]].
  - eexists. apply red_let_push.
  - destruct (two_fresh_config_vars (trm_lit l u; stack_nil; empty; empty; Lv))
      as [y [w [Fresh Distinct]]].
    destruct l.
    + eexists. apply red_let_fun; eauto.
    + eexists. apply red_let_obj; eauto.
Qed.
End InitialProgress.

Require Import TFree InertContext HeapCorrespondence EnvCorrespondence ConfigNotations.
 
Lemma tfree_opening :
  (forall v t, tfree_trm v t -> forall n x, tfree_trm v (open_rec n x t)) /\\
  (forall v l, tfree_lit v l -> forall n x, tfree_lit v (open_rec n x l)) /\\
  (forall v d, tfree_def v d -> forall n x, tfree_def v (open_rec n x d)) /\\
  (forall v ds, tfree_defs v ds -> forall n x, tfree_defs v (open_rec n x ds)).
Proof.
  apply tfree_mutind; intros; simpl;
    eauto using tfree_trm, tfree_lit, tfree_def, tfree_defs.
Qed.

Lemma context_binding_in_domain G x T :
  ctx_binds x T G -> x \\in ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  induction 1; simpl; try rewrite in_union; auto using in_singleton_self.
Qed.

Lemma variable_typing_in_domain (m : Mode) G Go e x T :
  @ty_var m G Go e x T -> x \\in ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  induction 1; eauto using context_binding_in_domain.
Qed.

Lemma visibility_hide_domain (m : Mode) G :
  ctx_dom (vis_hide m G) = ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  destruct (mode_visibility' m); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma method_context_domain (m : Mode) G Go z TZ c TC :
  ctx_dom (ctx_obj_met m G Go z TZ c TC) =
  \\{c} \\u (\\{z} \\u ctx_dom (ctx_obj G Go)).
Proof.
  destruct Go; simpl; now rewrite visibility_hide_domain.
Qed.

Ltac split_core_tfree :=
  match goal with
  | H : tfree_trm _ (trm_var _) |- _ => inversion H; subst
  | H : tfree_trm _ (trm_apply _ _) |- _ => inversion H; subst
  | H : tfree_trm _ (trm_read _ _) |- _ => inversion H; subst
  | H : tfree_trm _ (trm_write _ _ _) |- _ => inversion H; subst
  | H : tfree_trm _ (trm_call _ _ _) |- _ => inversion H; subst
  end.

Lemma executable_vars_in_context (m : Mode) :
  (forall G Go e t T, @ty_trm m G Go e t T ->
    forall v, tfree_trm v t -> v \\in ctx_dom G) /\\
  (forall G Go e l T, @ty_lit m G Go e l T ->
    forall v, tfree_lit v l -> v \\in ctx_dom G) /\\
  (forall G Go e d D, @ty_def m G Go e d D ->
    forall v, tfree_def v d -> v \\in ctx_dom (ctx_obj G Go)) /\\
  (forall G Go e ds T, @ty_defs m G Go e ds T ->
    forall v, tfree_defs v ds -> v \\in ctx_dom (ctx_obj G Go)).
Proof.
  destruct tfree_opening as [OpenTrm [OpenLit [OpenDef OpenDefs]]].
  apply rules_mutind; intros.
  all: try (split_core_tfree; eauto using variable_typing_in_domain; fail).
  all: try (solve [eauto using variable_typing_in_domain]).
  all: try match goal with
  | H : tfree_trm _ (trm_let _ _) |- _ => inversion H; subst
  | H : tfree_trm _ (trm_lit _ _) |- _ => inversion H; subst
  | H : tfree_lit _ (lit_fun _ _) |- _ => inversion H; subst
  | H : tfree_lit _ (lit_obj _ _) |- _ => inversion H; subst
  | H : tfree_def _ (def_typ _ _) |- _ => inversion H
  | H : tfree_def _ (def_fld _ _) |- _ => inversion H; subst
  | H : tfree_def _ (def_met _ _) |- _ => inversion H; subst
  | H : tfree_defs _ (defs_cons _ _) |- _ => inversion H; subst
  end.
  all: try (solve [eauto using variable_typing_in_domain]).
  all: try match goal with
  | H : tfree_defs _ defs_nil |- _ => inversion H
  end.
  all: try match goal with
  | L : vars, v : var |- _ =>
    let w := fresh \"w\" in let Fresh := fresh \"Fresh\" in
    let Neq := fresh \"Neq\" in
    destruct (var_fresh (L \\u \\{v})) as [w Fresh];
    rewrite notin_union in Fresh; destruct Fresh as [Fresh Neq];
    rewrite notin_singleton in Neq;
    match goal with
    | IH : forall x, x \\notin L -> forall v, _ -> _ |- _ =>
      specialize (IH w Fresh v)
    end
  end.
  all: try match goal with
  | IH : tfree_trm _ (open_rec _ _ _) -> _ |- _ =>
      feed specialize IH; [eauto|]
  | IH : tfree_defs _ (open_rec _ _ _) -> _ |- _ =>
      feed specialize IH; [eauto|]
  end.
  all: try match goal with
  | H : _ \\in ctx_dom (ctx_push _ _ _ _) |- _ =>
      simpl in H; rewrite in_union, in_singleton in H; intuition
  | H : _ \\in ctx_dom (ctx_obj _ (objctx_lit _ _)) |- _ =>
      simpl in H; rewrite in_union, in_singleton in H; intuition
  end.
  all: try match goal with
  | IH : forall z, z \\notin ?L -> forall c, c <> z -> c \\notin ?L -> forall v, _ -> _ |- _ =>
      let z := fresh \"z\" in let c := fresh \"c\" in
      let Hz := fresh \"Hz\" in let Hc := fresh \"Hc\" in
      destruct (var_fresh (L \\u \\{v})) as [z Hz];
      destruct (var_fresh (L \\u (\\{v} \\u \\{z}))) as [c Hc];
      repeat rewrite notin_union in Hz, Hc;
      repeat rewrite notin_singleton in Hz, Hc;
      destruct Hz as [HzL HzV];
      destruct Hc as [HcL [HcV HcZ]];
      pose proof (IH z HzL c HcZ HcL v ltac:(eauto)) as Dom;
      rewrite method_context_domain in Dom;
      repeat rewrite in_union in Dom;
      repeat rewrite in_singleton in Dom;
      intuition
  end.
Qed.

Definition runtime_canonical_forms (m : Mode) G (e : renv) (s : heap) :=

    ctx_k G x v_ref -> exists y ds z,
